name: manual_0c8afc
claim: Before presenting a policy or security question to the operator as an open decision, search the ratified record first (docs/v2 ADRs, off-repo references, PT DECISIONS and lessons) and cite what already decides it; a proposal that duplicates a ratified mechanism must be retracted, not offered as a choice.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23: the single-use escalation proof was framed as an open ledger-owner and TTL decision and a new jti ledger was proposed, but Phylax P5 one-use consume, the 5400/9900/900/300/60 second durations and grant single-use were already ratified. The operator had to point at the existing record. Recovering the decision cost a turn and a board retraction.
